verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows LocalAI exposes OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and MCP APIs and supports many model types (text, vision, voice, image), but none of the provided evidence specifically mentions embedding model support or an embeddings endpoint for retrieval/search use cases. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an /embeddings endpoint or embedding model backends, example usage for retrieval/search, and any independent confirmation of embedding support.
